description: This file contains the implementation of the CalculatorProgrammerBitFlipPanel class, a user control for a calculator app that manages bit flipping in programmer mode, including event handling, automation property updates, and UI element initialization.

classes.name: CalculatorProgrammerBitFlipPanel
classes.description: A sealed partial class representing a user control for flipping bits in a programmer calculator mode, handling UI interactions, property changes, and automation updates.

methods.name: CalculatorProgrammerBitFlipPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bit flip panel, setting default states, and assigning flip buttons.

methods.name: ShouldEnableBit
methods.description: Determines if a specific bit index should be enabled based on the bit length.

methods.name: OnLoaded
methods.description: Event handler for the control's loaded event, subscribing to property changes.

methods.name: OnUnloaded
methods.description: Event handler for the control's unloaded event, unsubscribing from property changes.

methods.name: SubscribePropertyChanged
methods.description: Subscribes to the ViewModel's property changed events and updates UI states accordingly.

methods.name: UnsubscribePropertyChanged
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the ViewModel's property changed events.

methods.name: OnPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles property change notifications from the ViewModel, updating UI and automation properties.

methods.name: AssignFlipButtons
methods.description: Initializes the array of flip button controls with references to UI elements.

methods.name: OnBitToggled
methods.description: Handles toggle events for individual bit flip buttons, executing button press commands.

methods.name: GenerateAutomationPropertiesName
methods.description: Generates a descriptive automation name for a bit position based on its index and value.

methods.name: UpdateCheckedStates
methods.description: Updates the checked state of all flip buttons based on the ViewModel's binary digits.

methods.name: UpdateAutomationPropertiesNames
methods.description: Updates automation property names for all flip buttons.

methods.name: GetIndexOfLastBit
methods.description: Returns the highest index for a given bit length.
